This account-bound client adds no authentication mode/session route, UI rendering or analytics event; offline account fixtures establish no webmail credential/session coverage.

One invocation makes one immediate request on the selected account through direct or WHM-bridged UAPI, with ordinary Flag outcome. Selectors are lazy and cached without I/O or metadata reset. No implicit rendering, HTML/script evaluation, URL navigation/fetch/fallback, local file access, path normalization, extra request, cache of server data, retry or rollback.

Data is a required nonnull object with optional known fields; empty objects are valid, absent data or explicit null mismatches. Existing empty JSON array object compatibility and unknown-field filtering remain unchanged. UAPI status 0 and outer WHM failures still throw before payload validation. Inspect responseMeta() warnings and raw metadata, including after a mismatch.

Inputs are ordinary noncredential selectors; returned content, paths, URLs and metadata may be private. Existing SensitiveParameter protections cover library-owned response frames, not caller-readable payloads, mismatch payloads or third-party transport traces.
